# Unified Water Body Topology Fixture

`water_body_geometry_report.json` is generated by the `water_surface_runtime`
test group when `WATER_BODY_GEOMETRY_REPORT` names the output path. The report
is local geometry evidence only: it proves deterministic closed-mesh topology
for flat, raised-corner, and depressed-corner 16x16 frames. It is not render,
dielectric-transport, package, publication, or scene-promotion proof.
